narration.say: On November 14th, SpaceX's tower caught a Starship back from orbit.
Braking on engines alone would need about seven kilos of fuel per kilo of ship.
cues: of fuel per kilo of ship.

narration.say: So the air does the braking: it falls on its belly, heat shield forward.

narration.say: Then it flips upright and lights its engines.
The arms close on two pins that stick out about a foot.
